This video was one of the most successful videos on [[Immanuelle's YouTube Channel]]. It came after a string of successful videos and is indicative of a trend of her ability to produce videos that get lots of views

== Content ==
It is the second video with the new outro

== Performance ==
[[File:Elon Musk wants you to die first 4 hours.png|thumb|First four hours performance]]


The video had a successful premiere and shot up in views pretty rapidly over the first couple hours due to reddit primarily. It levelled off around the 3 hour mark, which may be the result of lower youtube activity at that time

I’m convinced by weight class is too low to compete on Elon Musk topics at the moment

Notably though I saved the video from mediocrity by changing the thumbnail

On November 28th I realized switching to making the video with audacity actually substantially worsened the audio quality and my microphone headphones messed with my ability to hear static. Same with [[Making religion customer-centric]], although that video benefitted from being a bit less clickbaity.

It had an issue with audio due to recording with audacity over OBS, this likely contributed to lower viewer retention
